# bash completion for jet (generated by `jet completions bash`)
_jet() {
local cur prev cmds flags
COMPREPLY=()
cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
cmds="run check test build dev serve debug repl new fmt fix lint explain doctor env bind add remove fetch update store gc publish yank schema semindex impact vendor audit sbom emit eval bench completions man lsp version upgrade help"
flags="--json --color --version --emit-rust --check --small --locked --annotated --force --message --before --spdx --cyclonedx --advisory-db --vendor-dir --sbom --verbose --online --fix --dry-run --try-anyway --restart --swap --watch --project --pure --freestanding --allow-impure --target --explain-partition --capabilities-json --update-snapshots --coverage --rust -u --release --profile --a11y"
if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$flags" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
if [[ $COMP_CWORD -eq 1 ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$cmds" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
}
complete -F _jet jet
